reasoning: 23.4（MW5）規定按下 widget 的 Source 按鈕（以目前來源加下箭頭呈現）會開啟 Sources Pop up。步驟以 spec 描述的呈現方式指認該按鈕（目前播放來源旁帶下箭頭），而非自創標籤——page 38 截圖顯示該處為來源名稱加向下箭頭，與條文一致。ER 需同時陳述彈窗已開啟且列出可選來源，只寫「彈窗顯示」無法排除空彈窗。容器錨定：ch23 有三個容器——Home Screen 上的 Media Widget 本體、由 widget 的 Source 按鈕開啟的 Sources Pop up、以及由 widget 的 "All Presets" 按鈕開啟的彈窗。第三者與 ch18 同名彈窗是否為同一個尚未裁決（A-030），故 ER 一律以入口路徑指稱而非名稱。 本筆觀察 Media Widget 本體與其開啟的 Sources Pop up。優先級：是 widget 上切換來源的唯一入口，訂 P1。

tcs.test_item:
The system shall display the Sources Pop-up when the Source button is pressed in the Media Widget.

(Source button pressed in the Media Widget)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A USB drive containing at least three files with a valid audio format and full metadata is connected to the HU
2. USB is the active source on the HU and a track is playing
3. The Media Widget is displayed on the Home Screen
4. At least two audio sources are available on the HU
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press "Home" on Main Menu Bar to open the Home Screen
2. Press the source button in the Media Widget, shown as the currently playing source with a down arrow next to it, and read the content displayed on the HU
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Home Screen is displayed and the Media Widget is displayed on it
2. The Sources Pop up is displayed and the available audio sources are listed in it
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
